from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class TMP126_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16  # 16-bit registers

    def __init__(self):
        # Initialize all registers to their reset values
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x0000,  # TEMP_RESULT
            0x01: 0x0000,  # SLEW_RESULT
            0x02: 0x0000,  # ALERT_STATUS
            0x03: 0x0006,  # CONFIG
            0x04: 0x0016,  # ALERT_ENABLE
            0x05: 0xF380,  # TLOW_LIMIT
            0x06: 0x2A80,  # THIGH_LIMIT
            0x07: 0x0A0A,  # HYSTERESIS
            0x08: 0x0500,  # SLEW_LIMIT
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr in self.regs:
            return self.regs[addr]
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Register {addr} not found")

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr in self.regs:
            if addr == 0x03:  # CONFIG register
                # Handle special cases for RESETS and AVG fields
                if (data & 0x80) != 0:  # RESETS bit 8 is set
                    self.regs[addr] = 0x0006  # Reset to default
                if (data & 0x10) != 0:  # AVG bit 4 is set
                    self.regs[addr] &= ~0x10  # Clear AVG bit
            elif addr == 0x04:  # ALERT_ENABLE register
                if (data & 0x10) != 0:  # DATA_READY_ALERT_EN bit 4 is set
                    self.regs[addr] &= ~0x10  # Clear DATA_READY_ALERT_EN bit
            elif nbytes == 1:
                # Update only bits 15:8 for single-byte access
                self.regs[addr] &= 0xFF00  # Mask low byte
                self.regs[addr] |= (data & 0xFF) << 8  # Shift and update high byte
            else:
                # Full register update for multi-byte access
                self.regs[addr] = data
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Register {addr} not found")
